name: TX-37
label: Safe D

key_factors: Casar's large fundraising and cash advantage
model.rationale: The D+30 district fundamentals, Casar's roughly ten-to-one fundraising edge, and prediction markets pricing him near 97% all point to a safe Democratic hold. No polls or expert ratings contradict that picture.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or unexpected outside spending against Casar would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Greg Casar seeks reelection in a heavily Democratic Austin-area district with a D+30 partisan lean. He has raised about $1.17 million and holds nearly $600,000 on hand, while Republican Lauren Peña has raised under $120,000 with almost no cash remaining. No outside groups are spending against Casar, and no independent polls of the race are available.

Prediction markets price Casar's chances near 97%, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no expert ratings flagging the race and no polling suggesting competition, the seat is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty limited to turnout variation rather than a genuine contest.
